description: This file defines the TasksViewEdit class, which extends the ViewEdit class, and manages the display and pre-display logic for the 'edit' view of the 'Tasks' module in the SuiteCRM application. It handles setting task status based on request parameters and managing duplication logic.

classes.name: TasksViewEdit
classes.description: A class that manages the editing view of the Tasks module, including setting defaults and handling display logic.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Sets the task status to empty or 'Completed' based on request parameters before the display is rendered.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles logic during display, particularly setting default status if duplicating records, then calls parent display method.
